shots.name: T01_boss_wide
shots.log: [+G.time.toFixed(2), G.hero.state, Math.round(G.hero.hp), G.boss.active, G.boss.mode, Math.round(G.boss.hp), G.enemies.count()]
shots.setup: G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) { G.ember.champions().endDuel(); window.__d = null; } G.champ = null; G.ember.setSide('water', { place: false, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.42); const a = G.world.data.arena; G.quest.botDrive = null; G.quest.debugRingAll(); G.hero.pos.set(a.x, a.z + 6, -a.y); G.hero.prev.copy(G.hero.pos); G.hero.inv = 1e6; const cx = a.x, cz = -a.y; let px = null, py = 0, pz = 0, tx0 = 0, ty0 = 0, tz0 = 0; G.filmCam = (dt) => { const c = G.camera, h = G.hero.drawPos, b = G.boss.head; let dx = h.x - b.x, dz = h.z - b.z; const L = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; dx /= L; dz /= L; const tx = (h.x + b.x) / 2, ty = (h.y + b.y) / 2, tz = (h.z + b.z) / 2; let x = tx + dx * 30, z = tz + dz * 30; const r = Math.hypot(x - cx, z - cz); if (r > 38) { x = cx + (x - cx) * 38 / r; z = cz + (z - cz) * 38 / r; } const y = ty + 7; const k = px === null ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-2.2 * dt); if (px === null) { px = x; py = y; pz = z; tx0 = tx; ty0 = ty; tz0 = tz; } px += (x - px) * k; py += (y - py) * k; pz += (z - pz) * k; tx0 += (tx - tx0) * k; ty0 += (ty - ty0) * k; tz0 += (tz - tz0) * k; c.position.set(px, py, pz); c.up.set(0, 1, 0); c.fov = 62; c.updateProjectionMatrix(); c.lookAt(tx0, ty0, tz0); c.updateMatrixWorld(); }; 'ok'

shots.name: T02_fire_air
shots.setup: (() => { const h = G.hero, V = G.camera.position.constructor; G.filmCam = null; G.ember.setSide('fire', { place: true, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); h.maxHp = h.hp = 900; h.tide = h.maxTide; for (const k in h.powers) h.powers[k] = true; const yaw = 0.9; h.respawn(new V(410, 140, 748), yaw); h.fireAir = true; h.air = true; h.fly = true; G.camYaw = yaw; G.camPitch = 0.1; window.__n = 0; window.__foes = G.ember.raidNow(3) || []; return 'ok'; })()
shots.each: const h = G.hero; window.__n++; const n = window.__n; const w = { my: 0, mx: 0, boost: true }; h.inv = 1e6; h.tide = h.maxTide; const foes = (window.__foes || []).filter((e) => e && e.hp > 0); foes.forEach((e, k) => { if (e.hp < 60) e.hp = 300; if (n % 60 === 1) { const a = G.camYaw + (k - 1) * 0.45, r = 7 + k * 2.5; e.pos.set(h.pos.x + Math.sin(a) * r, h.pos.y + 0.6 - k, h.pos.z + Math.cos(a) * r); } }); const PP = { 12: 'atk', 26: 'atk', 40: 'atk', 70: 'dash', 100: 'spin', 130: 'atk', 144: 'wave' }; if (PP[n]) w[PP[n]] = true; w.my = n < 60 ? 0.2 : 0; Q.drive(w);

shots.name: T03_tornado_wide
shots.setup: G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) { G.ember.champions().endDuel(); window.__d = null; } G.champ = null; G.ember.setSide('water', { place: false, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.42); Q.start(); G.bot = null; G.quest.debugRingAll(); G.filmCam = null; const h = G.hero; h.tide = h.maxTide || 100; h.hp = h.maxHp = 900; const V = h.pos.constructor; Q.swimAt(-120,-560,-0.8); Q.aim(-1,-0.12,0.02); for (const [dx,dz] of [[12,4],[-10,8],[6,-12],[-13,-5],[15,-3]]) G.enemies.spawn('reaver', new V(h.pos.x+dx, -2, h.pos.z+dz)); Q.drive({my:0,mx:0,ud:0,boost:false}); F.path([{t:0,p:[-80,-548,2.6],at:[-120,-560,13],fov:62},{t:7,p:[-86,-550,3.4],at:[-120,-560,15],fov:62}]); 'ok'

shots.name: T04_fire_basalt
shots.setup: (() => { const h = G.hero, HN = G.hornets, N = HN.nest; G.filmCam = null; G.ember.setSide('fire', { place: false, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); h.inv = 1e6; h.endFly(); h.pos.set(N.x + 18, Math.max(N.y, 4) + 8, N.z - 6); h.prev.copy(h.pos); h.vel.set(0, 0, 0); h.air = true; h.land = false; h.fireAir = true; h.launchT = 9; HN.S.cool = 0; HN.S.callT = 0.05; G.camYaw = Math.atan2(N.x - h.pos.x, N.z - h.pos.z); G.camPitch = 0.12; window.__n = 0; return 'ok'; })()
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero; h.inv = 1e6; const w = { boost: n > 5 && n < 30, mx: 0, my: 0 }; if (n === 35 || n === 50 || n === 65 || n === 95) w.atk = true; if (n === 80) w.dash = true; if (n === 120) w.wave = true; Q.drive(w);
